summary: Transforms audio between time-domain samples and frequency-domain magnitude/phase data using FFT controls for analysis and visualization.
key_concepts: Audio Spectrum CHOP calculates and displays the frequency spectrum of input audio channels.
Visualization mode emphasizes higher-frequency levels and lower-frequency ranges to make spectra easier to read.
Time to Magnitude and Phase mode creates magnitude and phase channels for each input signal.
Magnitude and Phase to Time mode reconstructs time-domain audio from compatible spectrum-domain channels.
FFT Size trades frequency accuracy against recency, cook cost, and temporal latency.

key_params.name: timetoraw
key_params.note: Convert time samples to magnitude and phase

key_params.name: rawtotime
key_params.note: Convert magnitude and phase back to time samples

key_params.name: frequencylog
key_params.note: Use logarithmic frequency scaling for perceptual readability

key_params.name: highfreqboost
key_params.note: Boost higher frequencies for visual balance

common_gotchas: FFT size trades time resolution against frequency resolution and latency.
Visualization boost is useful for graphics but can distort analytical amplitude interpretation.
Time-to-spectrum and spectrum-to-time modes expect different channel semantics.
Use a stable sample rate and window size before mapping bins to visual bands.
